Affiliate and medical disclosure

Last updated October 30, 2026

Affiliate links

Peptide Chooser is supported by affiliate commissions. Some links on this site go to sellers or services that pay us a commission if you make a purchase or sign up. This costs you nothing extra.

Affiliate links are labeled where they appear. Commissions do not affect our ratings, rankings or which products we include. Sellers without an affiliate program are rated and listed on the same terms.

We may take part in affiliate programs run by individual brands and by affiliate networks. We will list the networks we work with on this page as those relationships start.

Not medical advice

Everything on this site is general information for education. It is not medical advice, diagnosis or treatment, and it does not replace a consultation with a licensed clinician.

Some products discussed on this site are not approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for the uses described. Where that is the case, we say so. Do not start, stop or combine any treatment without speaking to a clinician.

No sales

We do not manufacture, sell or ship any product.
